approach: The ELF statically recompiled to C++ with PS2Recomp as the reference, then replaced by a native C port built from the reverse-engineered formats and game code
notes: The native port plays from start to end from your own disc: front end and attract mode, the seven cities with challenges and bosses, the other modes, up to four players, sound, music and saving, with GTAO and SMAA/MSAA. Played on Windows; the Switch, phones and controllers are not yet tried on real hardware. The recompiled base runs the front end and Las Vegas. After v1: the Midway Classics arcade games.
help: Testing on Switch, Android and controllers
